description: Weight and body composition measurements over a range, from a Garmin smart scale or entered manually in Garmin Connect, returned as Garmin sends them: weights are in grams (74000 = 74 kg); date is the local measurement time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'. Often empty, since it needs a smart scale or manual entries. When nothing was recorded in the range, the result holds only previousDateWeight, the last measurement before it: check its calendarDate before treating it as current. Up to 92 days per call: pass a period (e.g. last_7_days, last_30_days, this_month) or start_date/end_date. For longer histories, make several calls.

end_date.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Defaults to start_date. Max span 92 days.

period.description: Named period resolved in the user's time zone (weeks start Monday). Use instead of start_date/end_date.

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Required unless period is given.

name: get_weight
title: Weight
